column1: # split: xet-go commit 5e991e9 (Luke small/internal + GoForge data leaves).
# fork: local Luke-based fork commit 59952ae, integrated as the only BLAKE3 module.
# Nine alternating fresh-process samples; each pipeline sample runs three iterations.
# Controlled effect of NewSerial inside Xet's already-parallel batch. Same fork
# otherwise; nine alternating /usr/bin/time -l samples, 20 passes per process.
# Direct retained-split versus final serial-batch fork under the same method.
# Three alternating 20-pass samples at each GOMAXPROCS value. All rows produced
# one identical protocol identity. The fork keeps the win at every core count.
# Rejected global policy: force all public writes below 256 KiB serial. This
# helped 64/128 KiB but materially regressed 1 MiB, so serial operation remains
# explicit and is used only when Xet already owns the outer parallelism.
# Rejected experiment: avoid padding eigentrees to 16 KiB. It cut allocation
# substantially but regressed representative full-pipeline medians.
